text:
incident-bot: P1 alert for CygnusCorp (enterprise-vpc). Gateway streaming sessions failing with persistent timeouts and retries. Affected: dedicated-pool-12 in us-west-2. Start triage channel: #incidents. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/streaming-timeouts

kira (oncall): I'm on it. Paging marc and evan. Cygnus reporting dropped WS connections + 504s from their app gateway.

marc (eng-runtime): saw spike in upstream retry 504s -> downstream WS keepalive resets. Looking at proxy metrics now. Can you share customer logs or session IDs?

cygnus-sre: sending example conn id: conn-6882a3, started ~1773735500. They see reconnect loop and token loss for long-running streams (~>30s).

sasha (solutions): Cygnus says this impacts real-time telematics feed — customers see partial transcripts missing. We need a temporary mitigation before full fix.

kira (oncall): First containment: increase appgw idle timeout to 120s from 60s, and temporarily route Cygnus to hosted-fallback model in us-west-2a. Can infra do config change? @evan

ev an (infra): I can bump idle timeout on app gateway. Changing proxy keepalive now. 

infra-bot: change requested: appgw/cygnus/timeout -> 120s by evan at 1773735620.

marc (eng-runtime): Observed long-tail kv cache pressure on dedicated-pool-12; continuous batching tick aligns with timeout boundary. If we bump keepalive we may mask underlying proxy conn resets. Need full thread dump from proxy and runtime handles.

kira (oncall): Understood. For now apply two changes: 1) appgw timeout bump, 2) enable SSE fallback for streams >45s for Cygnus only. Sasha, can you coordinate with customer on fallback?

sasha (solutions): Reached out to Cygnus SRE. They approved SSE fallback for non-critical streams. Documenting steps: https://redwood/internal/cygnus-fallbacks

kira (oncall): marc, can you flip routing policy for Cygnus to prefer warm instances in pool-13 (same region) to reduce cold-starts?

marc (eng-runtime): I can make a policy change: add route override -> pool-13 (warm) for tenant cygnus-corp. Pushing now.

marc (eng-runtime): config snippet applied:

```
route_overrides:
  tenant: cygnus-corp
  preferred_pool: pool-13
  failover: dedicated-pool-12
```

marc (eng-runtime): After routing change I see connection success rate improve 18% within 2m. But a subset still hits 504 on proxy side.

cygnus-sre: reconnect rate dropped from 38% -> 22% after route change. Still seeing occasional 504 bursts during higher concurrency periods.

leah (acct): Cygnus is asking for an ETA for a permanent fix — they are escalating to their ops leadership. Any ballpark?

marc (eng-runtime): Need to identify root cause: likely proxy-initiated resets when streaming payloads cross 64KB boundary with our chunking. Plan: capture proxy dump + kernel TCP retransmit stats. Will escalate to eng-runtime on-call.

kira (oncall): I'm starting an on-call handoff to marc for continuity; I'll stay for customer comms until Cygnus SRE confirms SSE fallback behavior. 

incident-bot: On-call handoff: from kira -> marc at 1773736120. Handoff note: containment applied (appgw timeout bump, SSE fallback, routing override).

marc (eng-runtime): I'm owning the incident now. Next steps: 1) enable verbose proxy logs for cygnus tenant for next 30m; 2) collect pcap for impacted connections; 3) coordinate hotfix for streaming proxy chunking. Need infra approval for pcap capture.

evan (infra): Approved. Starting pcap capture on appgw-03 for tenant tag cygnus-corp. Will upload to secure bucket.

infra-bot: pcap capture started at 1773736305 -> destination: s3://redwood-incident-data/cygnus/17737363.pcap

marc (eng-runtime): Early analysis: saw FIN from appgw then immediate client reconnect. Retries causing transient token replays that the customer library treats as failure. We can patch runtime to be tolerant for one reconnect within 5s window for streaming sessions.

kira (oncall): That patch sounds good as a fast mitigation if safe. What are the risks?

marc (eng-runtime): Low risk. Adds idempotent join logic for stream sessions. I'll put PR up and request expedited review.

marc (eng-runtime): PR: https://git.redwood/r/runtime/pull/759 Fix: tolerant-stream-reconnect. Requesting hotpath review from evan and qa.

evan (infra): Can deploy hotfix to pool-13 canary group first. Will monitor for regressions.

incident-bot: deployment started: runtime/hotfix/759 -> canary pool-13b at 1773736950.

marc (eng-runtime): Canary shows stable streams for 10min, reconnect tolerance accepted. Rolling to pool-13.

incident-bot: deployment success: runtime/hotfix/759 -> pool-13 at 1773737320.

cygnus-sre: Confirming customer side: stream stability is back to expected levels, reconnects within tolerance no longer drop messages. They will keep SSE fallback enabled until end of day.

leah (acct): Customer communicated: "Thanks for quick help — will require a post-incident call tomorrow."

kira (oncall): Closing loop: severity lowered to P2. Will create postmortem and schedule blameless review with Cygnus. Assigning marc as incident lead.

marc (eng-runtime): Will draft postmortem. Root cause hypothesis: app gateway was issuing TCP-level closes on idle-ish streaming chunk boundaries; combined with our strict stream session semantics caused token-loss/replay detection. Follow-ups: fix proxy chunking, add telemetry for reconnects by tenant, harden session resume semantics.

kira (oncall): Thanks team. If anything regresses, re-open this thread or call with pager. :thumbsup:

cygnus-sre: Thanks all — appreciated fast response.
